proposed_from.topic: Dynamic DATE support body for calendar-varying finite-memory carryover. Fix finite periods, memory, absorbing treatment-path support, and a positive probability floor. Under consistency and pathwise conditional mean random assignment, define the exact coefficient-by-calendar-by-causal-lag loading tensor of unit/time fixed-effect regression and the normalized diagonal target tensor. Characterize the complete image generated by positive reshaping laws using the ordered Green/pair-mass structure; give a terminating exact membership law or separation certificate on finitely represented inputs; and, when the target is infeasible, return a certified closest loading and worst-case contamination over the declared bounded effect class. Add full-path augmented cross-fitted inference under either a correct generalized path propensity or correct full path-outcome mean. Consumer: the OpenTable state-of-emergency analysis and public ripw workflow, which gain interpretable current/lag target certification. PRESOLVE EVIDENCE REQUIRING VERIFICATION: Gram matrices and loading numerators were reduced to linear functions of pair masses. Cofactor null vectors give rational inverse membership tests on every one-dimensional kernel stratum; exact rational checks cover 24 admissible four-period supports, full five-period support, and a seven-path six-period fiber whose three-dimensional linear kernel is uniquely resolved by pair-product compatibility. The repaired assignment model excludes the latent-selection counterexample, and full-mean augmentation returns the target under either nuisance branch. A support-uniform rational grid certifies global loss approximation, but generic lifting and small cases alone are insufficient. UNRESOLVED BOTTLENECK: Classify every positive compatible pair-mass intersection of the loading kernel and ratio-floor constraints for arbitrary absorbing support, yielding the structural boundary and exact membership procedure without generic quantifier elimination. EARLY KILL TEST: Reproduce the seven-path six-period fiber at probabilities proportional to 1 through 7, enforce all pair-product compatibility equations, and recover the unique law; any method that drops it or admits incompatible positive kernel vectors must pivot. seed_details.anchor_location: Section 4, the paragraph immediately after Theorem 4.1, and Appendix C.5, especially equation (C.23)
seed_details.opportunity: Characterize, for every finite absorbing-path support and positive probability floor, the exact image of calendar-by-causal-lag DATE loadings and decide rational target membership with an attainable-law or nonmembership certificate.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Retain calendar time in the Frisch--Waugh--Lovell loading numerator, replace path probabilities by ordered pair masses, and then intersect the loading kernel with the positive pair-product variety and floor ratios rather than accepting the linear kernel as the image.
seed_details.destination_pair_search: Searches for calendar-varying DATE equations, absorbing-path loading images, pair-mass compatibility, and exact positive-law membership found no published theorem or public preprint occupying this target--method pair.
seed_details.red_team: A cynical referee may call the result immediate from the DATE quadratic system and generic real-algebraic elimination.
seed_details.rebuttal: The published solver is explicitly a nonconvex numerical search with no global or nonmembership guarantee, while generic elimination neither exposes the ordered boundary nor prevents incompatible positive kernel vectors from being accepted; the seven-path fiber shows that this compatibility step is substantive.

seed_details.anchor_location: Propositions 1--2, their auxiliary-regression weight construction, and Section 6
seed_details.opportunity: Derive the coefficient-by-calendar-by-causal-lag loading tensor for finite-memory TWFE under a positive reshaping law, including exact normalization and cross-lag contamination identities.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Replace cohort-by-relative-time indicators in the auxiliary regressions by the shifted finite-memory path matrix and retain calendar date rather than summing it out.
seed_details.destination_pair_search: The search found cohort-event-time decompositions and homogeneous dynamic RIPW, but no reshaped calendar-by-lag tensor under an arbitrary absorbing support.
seed_details.red_team: A referee may view this as a mechanical reindexing of Sun--Abraham weights.
seed_details.rebuttal: The path-law Gram inverse couples all causal lags and dates and is nonlinear in the reshaping law; the tensor is valuable mainly as the forward map needed by the selected inverse-image theorem.

seed_details.anchor_location: Appendix C.5, the discussion following equation (C.23)
seed_details.opportunity: When a requested dynamic target is outside the loading body, return a globally closest attainable tensor, an exact optimality certificate, and the attained worst-case contamination over a bounded calendar-lag effect class.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Replace multistart local minimization of the DATE residual by exact optimization over the ordered compatibility strata and evaluate the support function of the bounded effect class at the residual loading.
seed_details.destination_pair_search: The search found numerical DATE feasibility and sensitivity bounds for parallel-trend violations, but no global projection onto a positive reshaping-law loading body.
seed_details.red_team: A referee may say compactness plus exhaustive gridding already provides the answer.
seed_details.rebuttal: Gridding certifies only an approximation and cannot decide zero distance; the proposed exact certificate depends on the new structural boundary and gives a checkable global optimum on a nonconvex image.

seed_details.anchor_location: Theorem 3.4, Algorithm 1, Section 4, and the paragraph following Theorem 4.1
seed_details.opportunity: Construct a full-path augmented cross-fitted estimator of the normalized dynamic loading functional with valid inference on either one-correct-nuisance branch.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Replace the static baseline-only augmentation by the full conditional path-outcome mean and differentiate the generated Gram inverse and loading normalization inside the cross-fit expansion.
seed_details.destination_pair_search: The search found static RIPW robustness, group-time doubly robust DiD, and longitudinal full-history scores, but no branchwise influence-function result for a generated dynamic DATE loading tensor.
seed_details.red_team: A referee may regard the score as ordinary augmented inverse probability weighting.
seed_details.rebuttal: Consistency is algebraic, but regular inference with an estimated correct nuisance and a misspecified counterpart has a first-order drift; Dukes--Vansteelandt--Whitney show why ordinary product-rate arguments do not settle the union model.

seed_details.anchor_location: Sections 3--4 on finite-memory causal effects and the TWFE discussion in Section 5
seed_details.opportunity: Give a support-only necessary-and-sufficient rank classification for which causal-lag coefficient systems are estimable under every positive absorbing-path law.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Replace assignment-specific covariance rank checks by the common nullspace of all centered shifted-interval contrasts indexed by path pairs.
seed_details.destination_pair_search: No retrieved panel experiment or staggered-DiD paper gives the support matroid for finite-memory TWFE Gram nonsingularity.
seed_details.red_team: The result may be dismissed as the elementary fact that a positive sum of positive semidefinite matrices has the intersection of their kernels.
seed_details.rebuttal: That identity is correct and useful, but by itself it is a supporting lemma rather than a paper-level kernel; it is therefore folded into the selected seed.

seed_details.anchor_location: The design-based estimand characterization in Sections 3--4 and the concluding discussion
seed_details.opportunity: Describe the stratified limit of the dynamic loading body as the probability floor tends to zero and identify which boundary faces correspond to loss of lag rank, loading blow-up, or finite limiting tensors.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Let adoption-date cell masses approach the design boundary and analyze the ordered Green inverse on each support deletion rather than fixing a strictly positive design.
seed_details.destination_pair_search: The retrieved design-based staggered-adoption results characterize one realized weighted effect but not the Hausdorff or stratified limit of all reshaped dynamic effects.
seed_details.red_team: A referee may call this merely taking the closure of a semialgebraic image.
seed_details.rebuttal: The closure alone does not distinguish removable Gram singularities from divergent loadings, but the topic fixes a positive floor, so this direction is deferred rather than allowed to broaden the kernel.

seed_details.opportunity: Classify when a multidimensional linear loading kernel meets the positive pair-product toric variety in one ray, finitely many rays, or a positive-dimensional fiber.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Specialize toric factorization equations to edge products of one probability vector and exploit the total order of absorbing adoption dates to propagate adjacent ratios through the loading kernel.
seed_details.destination_pair_search: Toric factorization theorems characterize monomial images abstractly; the search found no ordered-interval loading kernel whose positive intersection is classified uniformly over supports.
seed_details.red_team: A referee may say the pair-product variety is just the rank-one symmetric matrix variety with known quadratic minors.
seed_details.rebuttal: The equations defining compatibility are known, but the hard object is their intersection with a target-dependent linear kernel and floor inequalities; the seven-path example has a three-dimensional linear kernel yet a unique compatible positive ray.

seed_details.anchor_location: Section 2.3 on choosing among DATE solutions and Appendix C.5 on dispersed reshaping laws
seed_details.opportunity: Choose a feasible reshaping law on the exact loading body to minimize a Pareto criterion combining score variance and worst-case off-target contamination, with a global certificate.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Replace maximum-minimum probability as the tie-breaker by a support-body optimization whose objectives are the influence-function variance and the bounded-effect support function.
seed_details.destination_pair_search: The search found efficiency-optimal imputation weights and dispersed DATE laws, but not a certified variance--interpretability frontier over reshaping distributions.
seed_details.red_team: A referee may view the criterion as an arbitrary tuning exercise.
seed_details.rebuttal: A minimax contamination constraint supplies an economic interpretation, but the frontier depends on the selected image theorem and is better treated as follow-on work.

seed_details.anchor_location: Theorems 1--2 and Proposition 6 on efficient imputation and representation of linear unbiased estimators
seed_details.opportunity: Characterize when an attainable dynamic RIPW coefficient and a prespecified imputation average have the same influence function, and derive the support boundary where equivalence fails.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Express both estimators as linear functionals of calendar-lag cell effects and compare their weights before analyzing variance.
seed_details.destination_pair_search: No retrieved paper gives an observed-support frontier for equality of these two dynamic targets.
seed_details.red_team: A referee may note that equality is tautological once the two weight arrays are set equal.
seed_details.rebuttal: A nontrivial seed would need an observable primitive frontier rather than equality of declared targets; the scan did not reveal enough structure to derive one, so the candidate is dropped.
